root_policy: Up to 8 uniform samples without replacement from each of four fixed game phases t0..74,75..149,150..224,225..298. Available ACTIVE decision roots only. With all recorded history before each observation, no future fields or teacher label used in root selection. An unrepresentable expert joint root is omitted and counted; no relabeling. All splits selected by game/terrain before fitting. Use only Master6 vs external opponents; publish all reasons for omission and all W/D/L.
label_scope: Historical public analysis includes every ladder game. Holdout excludes identified prior V3 training, validation, repository original-exam maps, selected auxiliary split and previous 26-map study. Timestamp and per-game separate descriptive exposure retained. Only policy imitation agreement can use these labels as held-out; native play needs other fresh maps.
